name: Azorius Arrester and Lavinia of the Tenth — detain is a "Detained by <player>" trait on what it detains
notes: Found by the audit (2026-11-18): "detain …" (CR 701.35: until that player's next turn the permanent can't attack or block and its activated abilities can't be activated) was skipped as a one-shot action and did nothing. It is now a trait like goad, naming the player who detained (_resolveTraitText). Azorius Arrester's fired trigger detains only its target, among the opponent's creatures; Lavinia's fired trigger detains each nonland permanent the opponents control with mana value 4 or less (Hill Giant, not Serra Angel, not your Bears). The unfired Arrester has no detain effect of its own: a trait verb in a permanent's own trigger waits for the trigger, a target too (it used to give the card a target picker).
